title: Foundations of a Behavioral Approach October 28, 2026
summary: Observation of Problem Behavior; what causes it and reccurance.
description: Foundations of a Behavioral Approach covers the primary skills to observe problem behavior from the person’s point-of-view and identify what causes it and what keeps it going. Through various examples, videos and discussion, participants will look at the components of any problem behavior - Antecedents, Behavior to target, and Consequences - and tie these to function (which can be loosely described as motivation). Getting to understand the “why” of the problem behavior will be shown through ABC data collection.
instructor: Liz Gerken Miller, Hira Raja, Lorne Bailey, Gloria Lumba, Brenda Overcast
